prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: picosoc-uart-div
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): 03c2eeb46b737837
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
Loopback with divider 64 sent 0xa5 but recv_buf_data latched 0xe0, causing TRAP uart data mismatch got 0xe0 want 0xa5. Start-bit half-period check uses full cfg_divider at line 84, but data-bit and stop-bit waits at lines 90 and 97 use (cfg_divider >> 4), sampling ~16x too fast. This early sampling captures the start-bit as data and shifts recv_pattern, corrupting the byte to 0xe0.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash 03c2eeb46b737837 in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
